validates.rationale: §3 now names the authN axis (the API authenticates the caller) and states the identity-translation mechanism — the authenticated caller is mapped at the app tier to a per-call-path least-privilege DB role against which the column/row grant is evaluated, satisfying the named-mechanism requirement at decision level.

The API->Store boundary identity translation is now explicit (end-principal identity mapped to a per-call-path DB principal rather than one shared service principal), with fail-closed semantics and a §8 deny-on-grant-unavailable verification row, making the BDD permit/deny pair realizable against a named mechanism.
